title: Early Church Foundation
short_answer: The early church began at Pentecost when the Holy Spirit came upon the apostles and they preached the Gospel.
summary: The Early Church began at Pentecost after the resurrection and ascension of Jesus. It was built on apostolic teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayer.
explanation: After Jesus ascended into heaven, the Holy Spirit came upon the apostles at Pentecost as promised. Peter preached the Gospel and about 3,000 people believed and were baptized. The early church devoted itself to the apostles' teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayer. Even though persecution arose, the church continued to grow and spread the message of Christ.
historical_context: The Church was established in Jerusalem under Roman rule and faced immediate persecution from Jewish authorities.
major_points: Peter preached the first Gospel sermon
common_questions: How did the early church start?
Why was the early church persecuted?
